sources.basis: Source/doublet volume influence, PG transpose velocity transform, finite material cores, and image signs.
Retain derivatives at the converged state for M/A/B and reuse the resulting frequency-response pencil.

theory_basis.implementation: Analytic position, source-strength and doublet-vector partials of the existing regularized quadrature kernel are captured once per geometry derivative assembly query. Only changed receiver rows and source columns are applied to each geometry perturbation. Nonlinear physical evaluation, shoulders, ground-source signs, scalar/per-receiver physical exclusions and core values remain. Unsupported derivative branches use full physical differences; vortex and volume maps share a 128 MiB bound.
theory_basis.limits: This is additional initial-assembly reuse in this implementation. It is not a claim of source-code, discretization, result, timing or complete final-Newton-reuse parity with ASWING.

assembly.scope: Correctness reproduction; concurrent validation, not a performance comparison. Saved full DAE48 A/M/G assembly with direct vortex and volume field partials enabled. Complete nonlinear physical residual remains unchanged.
